why_this_exists: Every fundamental panel in this project begins 2023-01-01, so every strategy on the dashboard was selected on 2023-2026 and not one has ever been evaluated on a period it was not chosen on. That is a data limit rather than a decision, and it is the single largest unaddressed weakness in 286 steps of work. Step 286 showed the fix is cheap when the method forces it: a long warmup buys an out-of-sample window at no cost in selection.
what_is_being_tested: The earnings-yield valuation book, rebuilt from SEC Financial Statement Data Sets for 2012-2022 using the same construction that was frozen for the forward clock: breadth 20, equal weight, quarterly, 50bps, ranked on earnings yield.
why_this_signal_and_not_the_others: It is the one that goes on a forward clock on 2026-09-11 and it is the growth-uncorrelated half of the frozen 50/50 blend. Rebuilding all dashboard signals to 2012 means redoing survivorship-safe universe construction for eleven extra years; rebuilding one is tractable, and this is the one whose answer changes what happens on Friday.
the_construction_is_fixed_in_advance: Breadth 20, equal weight, quarterly rebalance executed at the first weekly close strictly after the decision, 50bps on turnover, earnings yield ranked cross-sectionally. These are the frozen values from config/forward/valuation_earnings_yield_forward_v1.json and NONE of them will be varied. If the out-of-sample result is poor, the finding is that the in-sample result was selection, not that a different breadth should be tried.

declared_outcomes.supports_the_book: positive excess over an equal weighting of its own scored universe in 2012-2022, in the same direction as the 2023-2026 result
declared_outcomes.refutes_the_book: excess at or below zero over 2012-2022, which would mean the +14.5 and +10.7 point excesses measured in-sample are a property of the selection window rather than of earnings yield
declared_outcomes.inconclusive: coverage too thin to build at least 24 quarterly decisions with 20 priceable names each

no_gate_is_being_applied_here: This is a validation, not a candidate search. There is nothing to pass or fail beyond the declared outcomes above, and no version of this experiment produces a new strategy.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: The 2012-2022 universe will be rebuilt from FSDS filer rosters rather than from the existing classified_membership file, so it is a different universe construction than the in-sample book used and the two are not perfectly comparable. The comparison that matters is each period's book against ITS OWN scored universe, not one period's CAGR against the other's.
Price coverage for 2012-2022 comes from the existing panels which begin 2011-01-07, so the first year of FSDS data has limited price history behind it.
Delisted issuers are the survivorship risk. The FSDS roster is point-in-time by construction, which helps, but any issuer with no price series is invisible and that absence is not random.
